The '''Battle of Wayfar''' was an armed conflict between the citizens of the town of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] and a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] warband on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A roving warband of Tuskens terrorized the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]], destroying settlements and stealing [[Water/Legends|water]]. The survivors headed to Wayfar, where the town made a stand against the Tuskens in order to safeguard their water.
